## Project Overview

**olcRTC** is a WebRTC media-relay and signaling server for the Yandex Telemost
video conferencing service. The private working fork lives at
`https://github.com/dparilov/olcRTC`; upstream is
`https://github.com/openlibrecommunity/olcrtc`.

**Tech stack:** Go, WebRTC (pion/webrtc v4), Yandex Disk rendezvous,
Windows/Android clients, VPN full-tunnel (WinTun).

**Active work areas (as of 2026-04-29):**
- Windows MVP / full-tunnel testing (`feat/windows-full-tunnel`)
- SSO / auth branch (`v2-sso`, ahead 32 commits)
- E2E Windows testing, ARM testing, GUI validation

## Important Invariants

- **NEVER** start a session without `/read-context` (or `/recover-memory` if stale)
- **NEVER** end a session without `/archive-context` if facts were established
- **NEVER** ask @pariloff for information already in memory files
- **NEVER** write memory files manually. Use candidate-first flow by default:
  `manage-candidates.py --add` → `manage-candidates.py --promote-auto / --approve`.
  Direct `archive-batch-v2.py --write` is allowed only for explicitly approved low-risk direct L2 writes.
- **NEVER** silently accept a contradiction — archive correction, flag CONFLICT
- **NEVER** merge to `master` without @pariloff explicit approval
- **NEVER** copy VPS credentials or secrets into memory, candidates, or reports
- **IF** `last-write` > 24 hours → run `/recover-memory` before task work
- **IF** `/recover-memory` fails → report to @pariloff; do not proceed as if memory is current
- **Coder model:** use `meridiana/claude-opus-4-7` (alias `meridiana_opus47`); record actual if different
- **Reviewer model:** use `openai-codex/gpt-5.5` (alias `gpt55`) via codex agent
- **Repo dirty state:** current branch `v2-sso` has uncommitted changes — do not mix infra commits with implementation work
